visualCharacteristics.structure: product header row (image, name, price, Buy) + labelled spec rows

contentPattern: Row 1 (header) = empty first cell, then one cell per product: image, product name, price, bold Buy link. Each following row = spec label | one value per product. Rows with fewer cells are padded so columns stay aligned; the header is detected by its images/links and may be omitted.
reuseGuidance: Use for side-by-side spec comparison of 2-4 products where rows must line up. Put the section in a light style (section metadata style: light). For marketing-style product tiles without aligned specs use cards-product.
